newsitem.title: USA: Golden Star completes offering in France.
newsitem.headline: Golden Star completes offering in France.

text.p: Golden Star Resources Ltd said on Tuesday that its French subsidiary, Guyanor Resources SA, has completed its public offering today.
Guyanor received through the offering of 1.0 million of its class B shares in France, net proceeds of approximately 45.5 million French francs, or approximately US$8.92 million.

Guyanor's Class B Shares are now listed on the Nouveau Marche of Bourse de Paris in France in addition to its current listing on The Toronto Stock Exchange, Golden Star said. As a result of the offering, Golden Star's interest in Guyanor is approximately 69 percent, it said.
